notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. NVIDIA GPU server guide: driver/CUDA/container-toolkit installation on Ubuntu, post-install nvidia-smi settings, health monitoring with DCGM, a DCGM Prometheus exporter, MIG partitioning, kernel/OS tuning, topology checks, and common issues.

Following it can make the agent run many sudo commands: purge existing NVIDIA/CUDA packages (SKILL.md:34), add NVIDIA's signed apt repository and install drivers/toolkits, reconfigure and restart Docker, change GPU power/ECC/MIG/boost settings, append to /etc/security/limits.conf, and write /etc/rc.local with tee (SKILL.md:168-175), which overwrites any existing file. Medium because these are privileged host and hardware changes; acceptable because they are the standard setup steps for a GPU server the user is provisioning, the repository is added with a GPG keyring and signed-by (not a piped script), and nothing disables OS security controls.

Users should note: disabling ECC (SKILL.md:72) is labelled 'less safe' and is optional; overwriting /etc/rc.local and purging drivers should be confirmed on an existing server; the DCGM exporter runs the unpinned :latest image with SYS_ADMIN (SKILL.md:106-112). Related Skills (SKILL.md:218-221) link to skills outside this directory (../../local-ai/vllm-server/, ../../local-ai/llm-fine-tuning/, ../../../security/hardening/linux-hardening/, ../../../devops/observability/prometheus-grafana/); optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
